column1: # Evidence for the supported-games list. One row per Title ID; a missing row means
# "no record", which is never shown as a success.
# Columns: title ID <TAB> build <TAB> runtime <TAB> source <TAB> note
# Sources, and what each one actually says:
#   upstream-iphone / upstream-release  docs/UPSTREAM-USAGE.md: the inherited upstream gallery,
#       "All of these are tested on an iPhone and playable". It records the upstream project,
#       not a build or a run performed by this fork.
#       FIFA 23 macOS App and iOS IPA builds in both resource modes were built and byte-audited.
#   fork-report                         docs/VALIDATION-MATRIX.md: the user reported FIFA 23 running
#       on iOS; the report named no resource mode and no installed artifact hash.
#       base 1.0.0 rebuilt through registry/engine, byte audited, then its published Host
#       ran for 45 seconds with GL draws and SDK 3 video decoding; no full content acceptance.

column5: macOS base 1.0.0 external App built and byte-audited through registry/engine; bounded published-Host run reached GL draws/video; full gameplay, updates, DLC and iPhone unverified
